# 3D WEBGL INSTRUCTIONS

1. Use React Three Fiber 9 and Three.js r186.
2. Do not instantiate `THREE.Clock`. Accumulate time inside `useFrame((_, delta) => ...)` ref counters.
3. Wrap 3D Canvas instances in a `WebGLErrorBoundary` with `<FallbackScene />` CSS 3D fallback.
4. Clean up geometries, materials, and textures on component unmount.
5. Limit particle counts and geometry segments for mobile DPR efficiency.
